status_note: Observing only: this chapter counts and lists the state and dates of the conditions under which an AI can pay, receive and contract without a human in the loop. No judgment, no advocacy, no evaluation.

beta_rule: Chapter Beta is removed when every payment-rail row is verified against a primary source (zero not-verified rows) and the support-count series has fetched for 7 consecutive days.
